info.title: Beskar API
info.description:
Authentication and implemented whiteboarding v2 APIs.

**Try it:** [Sign in](/auth/login?returnTo=%2Fapi%2Fdocs), then use the browser-session option, or select BearerToken and paste a valid Zitadel JWT (without the Bearer prefix). The server currently verifies bearer JWTs using its OIDC ID-token verifier; opaque access tokens are not supported. Calls run against this origin with your permissions and can create real data.

Replace example space/parent IDs with your own. Generate an Idempotency-Key UUID for each new board or checkpoint batch and keep it with the same payload for retries. Login, registration and logout require browser navigation. Cookie sessions normally require HTTPS.

post.description: Creates a board in the v2 schema. Requires space edit_page permission and parent edit permission when nested. Generate a fresh UUID Idempotency-Key per create action; reuse it and the same body on retries. Replays return 201 with the original IDs. Unknown fields, invalid UTF-8 and trailing JSON are rejected. Maximum body: 16 KiB. V2 incremental checkpoints are supported. V2 retrieval and publication are not implemented yet; v1 readers cannot load this board.

parameters.description: Exactly one nonzero UUID. Generate with crypto.randomUUID(); retain for retries, replace for each new create action.

post.description:
Requires page edit permission and matching page/space membership. Appends one Yjs v1 batch and advances the existing draft atomically; the base snapshot remains unchanged. The draft row lock serializes sequence allocation. No expected-head or base-snapshot parameter is required.

Generate a UUID Idempotency-Key for each batch and retain it with the exact pending bytes until acknowledged. Matching retries return the original acknowledgement even if the head has advanced or the space was subsequently archived/soft-deleted, provided authorization and board membership still hold. Different actors may submit overlapping changes; Yjs handles their document effect. Acknowledgement confirms storage, not reception of other actors’ edits.

Maximum decoded update: 1 MiB (1048576 bytes). Maximum JSON body: 1.5 MiB (1572864 bytes). Client batching target: 256 KiB or two seconds of pending edits; that queue is not implemented by this endpoint. Images upload separately. Optional title metadata is saved atomically at this sequence. No snapshot compaction or permission provisioning occurs here. Unknown fields, extra JSON values and malformed Yjs v1 wire structures are rejected. Structural validation does not verify drawing schema or causal completeness. Deploy the whiteboard_updates and whiteboard_titles Liquibase changesets before using this operation. Title is authoritative checkpoint metadata; a title-only rename uses the empty Yjs update AAA=. Omitted title preserves the current value. Same key with another normalized title returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

get.description: Requires page edit permission. Creates a one-hour actor-scoped replay lease pinning an immutable base snapshot and captured head. Archived spaces remain readable; deleted spaces do not. No body, query parameters or idempotency key. Sequence fields are decimal strings. Follow downloadUrl and updatesUrl with the same authenticated identity. New saves do not enter this replay. Repeating the manifest request creates another lease and can capture a newer head. Deploy whiteboard_draft_replay.xml first. Top-level title is captured at headSequence; baseSnapshot.title remains the base title. Deploy whiteboard_titles.xml.

get.summary: Get a bounded draft update page
get.description: Use the opaque cursor from the manifest or previous nextCursor. Up to 64 whole updates and 4 MiB decoded bytes per page; Base64/JSON adds overhead. Sequences are contiguous and bounded by the original captured head. Follow nextCursor until complete=true and nextCursor=null. Retrying a cursor is stable while the lease is valid. A gap fails closed and may be detected on a subsequent page. Authentication and edit permission are checked on every request.

get.summary: Download a draft snapshot as binary
get.description: Raw Yjs v1 snapshot bytes. The actor-scoped replay must be unexpired and identify this snapshot. Supports resumable single-range downloads and conditional requests. PostgreSQL bytes are fetched in chunks of at most 256 KiB; an MVCC transaction remains open for the transfer. Expiry during an in-flight transfer does not truncate it; later requests require a valid lease. Storage failures after headers abort the transport; verify byte length and SHA-256 before applying the assembled snapshot. Future object storage can replace this reader behind the same application URL.

post.summary: Publish a whiteboard at a durable sequence
post.description: Requires edit permission. Reconstructs Yjs state through sequence and atomically creates its snapshot, version, and current publication pointer. Retries return the original version without moving the pointer. Keys are scoped to board and actor. Archived spaces reject new publications. Replay is bounded to 32 MiB and 10,000 updates. Requires whiteboard_publication.xml and the pinned Node/Yjs runtime. Title edits use optional checkpoint title metadata; the requested sequence determines the published title. Deploy whiteboard_titles.xml. Asset integration is deferred; asset records are preserved without validation or retention. Requires a client-generated PNG in preview.contentType/data. PNG is validated and stored atomically with publication; retries must keep the same sequence and image. 6 MiB JSON body limit. Deploy whiteboard_previews.xml. The server does not verify visual correspondence to the Yjs snapshot.

post.summary: Restore a published version to draft
post.description: Requires edit permission and an active space. Replaces the draft at expectedHeadSequence+1, increments restoreGeneration, and preserves the current publication. Concurrent changes return DRAFT_HEAD_CHANGED. Retry identical body/version/key for the original result. Old-generation checkpoints are rejected, including old checkpoint retries.

delete.description: Requires delete permission and an active space. Rejects boards with child pages. Atomically removes board content and core page; retains creation receipt identity to prevent resurrection by old retries. Missing boards return 204 after authorization. Does not recursively delete children.
